claim: Counts valid EML and MBOX messages, decodes standard MIME names and headers, and hashes readable attachments.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo plus shipped controlled fixtures; assert message, attachment, hash, RFC 2231 filename, and UTF-8 header results

claim: Message and attachment bytes stay on this device, and demo state stays in memory without changing real audit or preference storage.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a saved real audit and theme preference; open /demo, operate its theme control, leave demo, record requests, and prove localStorage and IndexedDB are byte-for-byte unchanged

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; wait for service-worker control, disable network, reload, and assert the completed audit

claim: Exports complete HTML, CSV, and JSON receipts, including messages without attachments and every selected folder file.
where: catalog description, how it works, report actions, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo plus controlled folder files; download all three receipts and inspect message and folder inventories

claim: A real audit report survives reload without storing message bodies or attachment bytes.
sandbox: fresh browser context; upload controlled EML, inspect IndexedDB, reload, and assert restored metadata

claim: The complete audit and all receipt formats are free and require no account.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter /demo without setup and assert all export actions are available

claim: The sample opens a complete audit with no setup.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /; click Try it with sample data; assert no real audit storage and completed results visible in the viewport

claim: Finds named attachment references that are missing from the selected attachment folder.
sandbox: fresh browser context; audit a controlled message naming an attachment with an empty folder; assert the missing metric, ledger status, and downloaded receipt

claim: Shows every selected attachment-folder file with its relative path and match status.
sandbox: fresh browser context; use controlled matched, ambiguous, and unreferenced folder files; assert each path and status in the visible folder ledger

claim: Makes no analytics, advertising, account, payment, or AI requests, and downloads receipts in the browser.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record landing, demo, real audit, and receipt-export requests; assert every request is an expected same-origin static GET

claim: Reset demo restores the bundled sample audit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; replace the sample with a controlled audit, reset, and assert the shipped four-message sample returns

claim: Clear local report removes the saved local audit summary without changing source files.
sandbox: fresh browser context; save a controlled real audit, exercise cancel and confirm, reload, and assert saved metadata is gone while the original fixture remains unchanged

claim: Reads selected EML or MBOX files only; it does not decrypt mail, access providers, or certify unselected files.
sandbox: fresh browser context; submit controlled encrypted-style input and a selected EML, assert rejection or selected-file-only receipt contents, and record no provider requests
